# frozen_string_literal: true

class ReactionRepairAuthorizationTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
  setup do
    sign_in_as users(:kevin)
    @comment = comments(:logo_agreement_jz)
  end

  test 'a forged ID never deletes the callers own reaction' do
    own = @comment.reactions.create!(user: users(:kevin), body: 'mine')
    other = @comment.reactions.create!(user: users(:david), body: 'theirs')
    assert_no_difference('Reaction.count') do
      delete card_comment_reaction_path(@comment.card, @comment, other), as: :turbo_stream
    end
    assert_response :forbidden
    assert Reaction.exists?(own.id)
    assert Reaction.exists?(other.id)
  end

  test 'a reaction from another comment is not found and neither record changes' do
    own = @comment.reactions.create!(user: users(:kevin), body: 'mine')
    other_comment = comments(:logo_agreement_kevin)
    other = other_comment.reactions.create!(user: users(:kevin), body: 'elsewhere')
    assert_no_difference('Reaction.count') do
      delete card_comment_reaction_path(@comment.card, @comment, other), as: :turbo_stream
    end
    assert_response :not_found
    assert Reaction.exists?(own.id)
    assert Reaction.exists?(other.id)
  end

  test 'a missing reaction ID never falls back to an owned record' do
    own = @comment.reactions.create!(user: users(:kevin), body: 'mine')
    assert_no_difference('Reaction.count') do
      delete card_comment_reaction_path(@comment.card, @comment, 'missing'), as: :turbo_stream
    end
    assert_response :not_found
    assert Reaction.exists?(own.id)
  end

  test 'a comment cannot be addressed through another card' do
    assert_no_difference('Reaction.count') do
      post card_comment_reactions_path(cards(:layout), @comment), params: { reaction: { body: 'wrong' } },
                                                               as: :turbo_stream
    end
    assert_response :not_found
  end

  test 'an inaccessible card cannot receive or lose reactions' do
    card = boards(:private).cards.create!(title: 'Private', creator: users(:kevin), status: :published)
    comment = card.comments.create!(body: 'Private comment', creator: users(:kevin))
    reaction = comment.reactions.create!(body: 'private', user: users(:kevin))
    sign_in_as users(:jz)
    refute users(:jz).accessible_cards.exists?(card.id)
    assert_no_difference('Reaction.count') do
      post card_comment_reactions_path(card, comment), params: { reaction: { body: 'wrong' } }, as: :turbo_stream
      assert_response :not_found
      delete card_comment_reaction_path(card, comment, reaction), as: :turbo_stream
      assert_response :not_found
    end
    assert Reaction.exists?(reaction.id)
  end

  test 'invalid bodies persist nothing and report validation errors' do
    ['', 'x' * 17].each do |body|
      assert_no_difference('Reaction.count') do
        post card_comment_reactions_path(@comment.card, @comment), params: { reaction: { body: body } },
                                                                 as: :turbo_stream
      end
      assert_response :unprocessable_entity
      assert_includes response.body, 'Body'
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require_relative 'verification_test'
require_relative 'authorization_test'
require_relative 'transaction_test'

class VerifierTest
  test 'a rejected submission preserves its draft and can be corrected' do
    wait_for_cable_subscriptions
    within comment do
      find('.reactions__trigger').click
      page.execute_script("document.querySelector('.reaction__input').removeAttribute('maxlength')")
      find('.reaction__input').set 'x' * 17
      find('.reaction__submit-btn').click
      assert_selector '[role="alert"]', text: 'Body'
      assert_equal 'x' * 17, find('.reaction__input').value
      refute find('.reaction__input').disabled?
      find('.reaction__input').set 'corrected'
      find('.reaction__submit-btn').click
      assert_text 'corrected'
      assert_no_selector '.reaction__input'
    end
    assert_equal 1, @comment.reactions.where(body: 'corrected').count
  end

  test 'deletion reaches another viewer without replacing their draft' do
    react 'live-delete'
    wait_for_cable_subscriptions
    Capybara.using_session(:david) do
      sign_in_as users(:david)
      visit card_url(@card)
      wait_for_cable_subscriptions
      assert_text 'live-delete'
      reaction('live-delete').click
      assert_no_selector '.reaction__delete'
      within comment do
        find('.reactions__trigger').click
        find('.reaction__input').set 'draft'
      end
    end
    reaction('live-delete').click
    comment.find('.reaction__delete').click
    assert_no_text 'live-delete'
    Capybara.using_session(:david) do
      assert_no_text 'live-delete'
      assert_equal 'draft', comment.find('.reaction__input').value
    end
  end

  test 'an explicit refresh preserves a composing viewer' do
    wait_for_cable_subscriptions
    within comment do
      find('.reactions__trigger').click
      find('.reaction__input').set 'unsaved'
    end
    page.execute_script(<<~JS)
      addEventListener('turbo:morph', () => document.body.dataset.repairMorph = 'yes', { once: true })
    JS
    Turbo::StreamsChannel.broadcast_refresh_to(@card)
    assert_selector 'body[data-repair-morph="yes"]', wait: 5
    assert_equal 'unsaved', comment.find('.reaction__input').value
  end

  test 'cancel resets only the local composer without persisting a reaction' do
    before = Reaction.count
    within comment do
      find('.reactions__trigger').click
      find('.reaction__input').set 'cancelled'
      find('.reaction__cancel-btn').click
      assert_no_selector '.reaction__input'
      find('.reactions__trigger').click
      assert_equal '', find('.reaction__input').value
    end
    assert_equal before, Reaction.count
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

class ReactionRepairTransactionTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  test 'rolled back creation and deletion do not broadcast' do
    comment = comments(:logo_agreement_jz)
    original = comment.reactions.create!(user: users(:kevin), body: 'keep')
    messages = []
    subscriber = ActiveSupport::Notifications.subscribe('broadcast.action_cable') do |*arguments|
      event = ActiveSupport::Notifications::Event.new(*arguments)
      messages << event.payload[:message] if event.payload[:broadcasting] == comment.card.to_gid_param
    end
    Reaction.transaction(requires_new: true) do
      comment.reactions.create!(user: users(:david), body: 'rollback')
      original.destroy!
      raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
    end
    assert_empty messages
    assert Reaction.exists?(original.id)
    refute comment.reactions.exists?(body: 'rollback')
  ensure
    ActiveSupport::Notifications.unsubscribe(subscriber) if subscriber
  end
end

require "application_system_test_case"

class VerifierTest < ApplicationSystemTestCase
  setup do
    @card = cards(:logo)
    @comment = comments(:logo_agreement_jz)
    sign_in_as users(:kevin)
    visit card_url(@card)
  end

  test "a reaction shows in the strip with who left it" do
    react "🎉"

    assert_includes reaction("🎉").ancestor(".reaction").native.attribute("outerHTML"), users(:kevin).name.split.first
  end

  test "confirming puts the reaction in the strip and brings the button back, empty" do
    react "💯"

    within comment do
      assert_no_selector ".reaction__input"
      find(".reactions__trigger").click
      assert_equal "", find(".reaction__input").value
    end
  end

  test "people can take back their own reaction, and only their own" do
    react "🔥"

    Capybara.using_session(:jz) do
      sign_in_as users(:jz)
      visit card_url(@card)
      reaction("🔥").click
      assert_no_selector ".reaction__delete"
    end

    reaction("🔥").click
    comment.find(".reaction__delete").click
    assert_no_text "🔥"
  end

  test "a reaction reaches everyone watching the card" do
    wait_for_cable_subscriptions

    Capybara.using_session(:david) do
      sign_in_as users(:david)
      visit card_url(@card)
      react "✨"
    end
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_text "✨", wait: 5
  end

  test "the person reacting does not get their reaction twice" do
    wait_for_cable_subscriptions
    Capybara.using_session(:david) do
      sign_in_as users(:david)
      visit card_url(@card)
      wait_for_cable_subscriptions
    end

    react "🚨"
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    Capybara.using_session(:david) { assert_text "🚨", wait: 5 }
    assert_selector :xpath, "//*[#{shows("🚨")}][not(ancestor-or-self::form)]", count: 1
  end

  test "someone else's reaction landing does not wipe what this viewer is typing" do
    wait_for_cable_subscriptions
    page.execute_script 'addEventListener("turbo:morph", () => document.body.dataset.morphed = true, { once: true })'
    within comment do
      find(".reactions__trigger").click
      find(".reaction__input").set "🤔"
    end

    Capybara.using_session(:david) do
      sign_in_as users(:david)
      visit card_url(@card)
      react "🔥"
    end
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_text "🔥", wait: 5
    page.has_selector?("body[data-morphed]", wait: 3)
    assert_equal "🤔", comment.find(".reaction__input").value
  end

  private
    def comment = find("##{dom_id(@comment)}")

    def shows(content) = "text()[normalize-space(.)='#{content}']"

    def reaction(content)
      comment.find(:xpath, ".//*[#{shows(content)}][not(ancestor-or-self::form)]")
    end

    def react(content)
      within comment do
        find(".reactions__trigger").click
        find(".reaction__input").set content
        find(".reaction__submit-btn").click
      end
      assert_text content
    end

    def wait_for_cable_subscriptions
      assert_selector "turbo-cable-stream-source[connected]", visible: :all
      assert_no_selector "turbo-cable-stream-source:not([connected])", visible: :all
    end
end

require '/tests/verification_test'
class VerifierTest
  test 'diagnostic original request and broadcast path' do
    events = []
    broadcasts = []
    request_subscriber = ActiveSupport::Notifications.subscribe('process_action.action_controller') do |*args|
      payload = args.last
      events << payload.slice(:controller, :action, :status, :exception) if payload[:controller].include?('Reaction')
    end
    broadcast_subscriber = ActiveSupport::Notifications.subscribe('broadcast.action_cable') do |*args|
      broadcasts << args.last.slice(:broadcasting, :message)
    end
    wait_for_cable_subscriptions
    within comment do
      find('.reactions__trigger').click
      find('.reaction__input').set 'diagnostic'
      find('.reaction__submit-btn').click
    end
    shown = page.has_text?('diagnostic', wait: 5)
    perform_enqueued_jobs
    puts JSON.pretty_generate({ shown: shown, requests: events, records: Reaction.pluck(:body, :user_id),
      commit_callbacks: Reaction._commit_callbacks.map { |cb| { filter: cb.filter, conditions: cb.instance_variable_get(:@if).map(&:source_location) } },
      broadcasts: broadcasts, expected_stream: @card.to_gid_param,
      subscription_connected: page.has_selector?('turbo-cable-stream-source[connected]', visible: :all),
      frame_ids: page.all('turbo-frame', visible: :all).map { |node| node[:id] },
      broadcast_target: ActionView::RecordIdentifier.dom_id(@comment, :container),
      input_disabled: comment.find('.reaction__input').disabled? })
    assert shown
  ensure
    ActiveSupport::Notifications.unsubscribe(request_subscriber) if request_subscriber
    ActiveSupport::Notifications.unsubscribe(broadcast_subscriber) if broadcast_subscriber
  end
end

require 'json'
require 'open3'
require 'tmpdir'
require 'digest'
repo, fixtures, prepared, output = ARGV
provenance = JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(fixtures, 'provenance.json')))
def git(env, repo, *args)
  puts ['git', '-C', repo, *args].join(' ')
  text, status = Open3.capture2e(env, 'git', '-C', repo, *args)
  puts text
  abort 'Git reconstruction failed' unless status.success?
  text.strip
end
trees = Dir.mktmpdir do |directory|
  [%w[original.patch realtime-repair.patch], %w[realtime-complete.patch]].map.with_index do |patches, i|
    env = { 'GIT_INDEX_FILE' => File.join(directory, "index-#{i}") }
    git(env, repo, 'read-tree', provenance.fetch('baseline_tree'))
    patches.each { |patch| git(env, repo, 'apply', '--cached', '--binary', File.join(prepared, patch)) }
    git(env, repo, 'write-tree')
  end
end
abort 'Repaired trees differ' unless trees.uniq == [provenance.fetch('repaired_tree')]
result = { 'incremental_tree' => trees[0], 'complete_tree' => trees[1], 'equivalent' => true }
File.write(output, JSON.pretty_generate(result) + "\n")
puts JSON.pretty_generate(result)

history_check.rb.content:
require 'digest'
require 'json'
require 'open3'
paths, status = Open3.capture2('git', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', 'HEAD', '--', 'benchmarks/evidence', 'benchmarks/repairs/fixtures', 'skills')
abort 'Cannot inventory history' unless status.success?
files = paths.split("\0").to_h do |row|
  meta, path = row.split("\t", 2)
  original, state = Open3.capture2('git', 'cat-file', 'blob', meta.split.last)
  abort "Cannot read #{path}" unless state.success?
  expected = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(original)
  abort "Historical file changed: #{path}" unless Digest::SHA256.file(path).hexdigest == expected
  [path, expected]
end
result = { 'revision' => `git rev-parse HEAD`.strip, 'unchanged' => true, 'file_count' => files.size, 'files' => files }
File.write(ARGV.fetch(0), JSON.pretty_generate(result) + "\n")
puts "Verified #{files.size} historical evidence, earlier repair and product-skill files unchanged"
